rows: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for UG (Under Graduate) Students

Through this scholarship scheme, students will receive a complete tuition fee waiver, Rs. 1,000 per month. The selected students must maintain CPA of 6.5 and above in all semesters to avoid withdrawal of allowance. The annual income of parents should not be more than Rs. 6 lakh. Students applying for this scheme must make a note of it.
Merit-cum-Means Scholarship Awarded by IIT Kanpur Alumni

IIT Kanpur offers this scholarship to 50 students. Students selected for this scheme will get an allowance of Rs. 2,000 per month. The selected students must maintain CPA of 8.5 and above in all semesters to avoid withdrawal of allowance. The annual income of parents should not be more than Rs. 4.50 lakh. Students applying for this scheme must make a note of it.
Support for PG and Ph.D. Students
Masters and Ph.D. students are eligible to apply for various scholarship schemes. Ph.D. and Master’s students of IIT Kanpur receive TA/ RA

Every year, IIT Kanpur awards sports scholarships to students based on their performance in sports. The selected students receive monthly assistance of Rs. 500 per month. The allowance is provided for nine months. Students who won Gold, Silver and Bronze medals in annual inter IIT sports meet will receive cash prizes.

rows: Candidates must have qualified 12th with Physics & Mathematics as main subjects. Besides this, He/ She must have Chemistry, Biology or Bio-Technology. Candidates belonging from general category must have cleared three diploma program in engineering with a percentage not less than 50 without any grace marks. Other candidates belonging from any of the reserved categories must have scored a minimum percentage of 45. Apart from this, parents of the applying candidate must be the domicile of Uttar Pradesh.

Candidates who hold B.Sc degree in any stream and have passed 12th examination having Mathematics as one of the subjects from any of the recognised university with a minimum aggregate of 50%. Candidates who belong from any of the reserved categories need to score a minimum percentage of 45%.

tables.heading: JPIET, Merrut MCA Eligibility Criteria 2020
rows: Candidates who are looking for admission in the MCA program must have cleared the three-year bachelor program with aggregate not less than 50% without any grace marks. tables.heading: JPIET, Merrut M.Tech Eligibility Criteria 2020
rows: Candidates who are looking for admission in the M.Tech program must have cleared the four-year bachelor program(B.Tech) with aggregate not less than 60% without any grace marks. Passing the MCA program from any of the university which is recognised by government body securing at least 60% marks.

The qualifying test will be used to construct the candidate merit list; however, the availability of seats will be determined by other variables such as the number of applicants, the number of seats available, and so on. Following the counselling session, the final admittance and seat block will be completed.

Counseling is the procedure through which applicants who have passed the Entrance test or qualifying exam finalize their seats and confirm their acceptance to the programme. In this case, you must go to the venue on the specified day with the relevant documentation to confirm your seat.
The following documents will be required: 10th, 12th, Transfer Certificate, Passport photo, and student signature.

Fill out the option-entry form and go to the counselling session after taking the admission exam and obtaining your results. After that, the student's documents are verified by the NIU, and the payment is made.
Students can fill out the application form both offline and online on the official website of The Noida International University.
Selection is based on the results of the Noida International University's GD/PI.

NIU counselors will contact you by phone or mail after the application process is completed. After reviewing the documents, they will determine whether the candidate is eligible for the admission exam.
10+2/10th ANM/ GNM/ B.Sc certificates, passport size photo, transfer certificate, signature to join Noida International University.

tables.heading: Noida International University PhD Admission
rows: To be admitted to NIU PhD programmes , candidates must have obtained a minimum of 55 per cent in Masters with linked disciplines.
There are no entrance exams; students must just meet the minimum requirements.

After completing the entrance exam and receiving your results from the NIU, fill out the option-entry form and attend the counselling session. The documentation of the students is then confirmed, and the payment is completed.

When you visit the official website of NIU, you may select from several different courses. The student can browse the course that interests him or her and apply online. Admissions can also be gained by just walking into the institution.
The application form can be completed both offline and online.
You can make a payment with a credit/debit card or through net banking (Rs 1,100 + GST). Visit NIU's official website for further information and specifications.
Candidates for the PhD programmes of Noida International University are chosen based on their GD and PI rounds performance.

A counsellor from Noida International University will contact you by phone or mail after the application process is completed. After reading the material, they will determine whether or not the person is eligible.

rows: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students

Students above the 80th percentile in their Class XII exams, pursuing regular courses in recognized colleges/institutions (AICTE, UGC, MCI, DCI approved), and not availing other scholarship benefits. Diploma students are not eligible. Parental income should be up to Rs. 4.5 lakh per annum.
Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Wards of States/UTs Police Personnel Martyred During Terror/Naxal Attacks

Dependent wards of State Police personnel martyred during Terror/Naxal attacks. They must be pursuing their first professional degree program (Engineering, Medicine, etc.) and have a minimum of 60% marks in their qualifying exam (10+2/Diploma/Graduation). Renewal requires passing each subsequent year with a minimum of 50% marks.
Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces and Assam Rifles

Wards/widows of deceased, disabled, or gallantry award recipient CAPFs & AR personnel, or wards/widows of retired/serving CAPFs & AR personnel (below Officer Rank). Must be pursuing a first professional degree (Engineering, Medicine, etc.) with 60% marks in qualifying exam. Renewal requires 50% in subsequent years.
National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students – Scholarship (Formally Top Class Education for Schedule Tribe Students)

Meritorious ST students pursuing Graduate/Post Graduate level courses in identified Institutions of excellence, Government and Private, in professional fields such as Management, Medicine, Engineering, Information Technology, Law etc.
Should have scored A Plus in all subjects in the SSLC Examination conducted by Board of Public Examinations, Kerala State.

Girl students who are natives of Kerala, belong to Muslim, Latin Catholic or converted Christian communities and are studying for degree, PG and professional courses in Govt/Aided colleges are eligible. Annual family income should not exceed Rs. 8 Lakhs.
